style: 3D animation, original character design, vivid saturated colors, high contrast
subject: exactly one bear and one fox, no other animals. ONE heavy brown bear, mustard cardigan, grumpy; his body fills the tall frame top to bottom
second_characters: ONE ginger fox, the bank, emerald vest
props: her key board with iron hooks; her plain red tag on his left ankle; her red stamp; his small gold key; his honey jar; her straw; his pillow; his stump
environment: bright den: his round red door glowing with daylight, her key board beside it, moss floor, teal clay walls, moss bed by a stump
lighting: warm sunbeam on his muzzle; turquoise glow from walls, daylight from his door
motion_rule: one continuous moving camera ending on each beat's focus; his body fills the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.sfx: 0.4 stamp slap, hook creak; 1.1 heavy flop into moss; 4.0 slap, oof; 5.4 head thud on stump; 6.9 jar slap on belly; 7.7 LOUDEST slurp; 8.5 belly thud; 9.5 key clink; 9.8 hook creak

timeline.a: exactly the first frame: he hangs upside down by his left ankle on her hook, kissing his gold key; close-up: her stamp slaps his red tag, he swings like a pendulum, his face swinging into the lens
timeline.c: face-on, the camera lunges at his upside-down face, his key hits the lens

timeline.a: she lifts her loop off her hook; he drops head-first, mouth moving
timeline.c: the camera dives down past her key board with his fall

timeline.a: he sprawls on the moss and, mouth moving, thrusts his gold key at the lens
timeline.c: landing low on the moss, his key at the lens

timeline.a: he, mouth moving, tucks his key into his cardigan pocket; she climbs his back onto his head
timeline.c: the camera rises up his back to her on his head

timeline.a: he, mouth moving; close-up: her stamp slams his belly, red print, his belly flies into the lens
timeline.c: the camera drops down his front to his belly

timeline.a: he, mouth moving, flops on his back onto his pillow
timeline.c: the camera flies between his head and her paw, top-down over his pillow

timeline.a: close-up: she yanks his pillow into the lens, his head knocks his stump
timeline.c: low by his stump, his pillow across the lens

timeline.a: he, mouth moving, lying on his back, slaps his honey jar onto his belly, hugging it; her straw comes down from the top into his jar
timeline.c: straight top-down above his body lying along the tall frame, sinking toward his jar

timeline.a: peak, close-up: her straw drains his honey in one gulp, his jar jerks up out of his paws, he lurches after it nose-first into the lens
timeline.c: the camera hurls itself down along her straw to his nose

timeline.a: he crashes belly-down at the lens, both his paws empty; she carries off his empty jar; she pulls his key from his pocket and drops it into his empty paws
timeline.c: low on the moss, face-on at his empty paws, her tail sweeping across the lens

timeline.a: close-up: eyes closed, he kisses his key as her loop yanks him up by his left ankle, upside down, back onto her hook
timeline.c: the camera shoots up with him and stops face-on at his upside-down face, as in the first frame
